evidence.quote: Dedicated Memory Size 192 GB  Dedicated Memory Type HBM3  Peak Memory Bandwidth 5.3 TB/s

notes.zh: 回答单卡显存容量与带宽的量级，供「一个模型能不能整卡装下」这类判断使用。不回答软件栈成熟度或迁移成本：该页只给硬件规格，ROCm 支持范围与框架版本需另查官方文档。
notes.en: Answers the order of magnitude of per-card memory and bandwidth, which is what a "does this model fit on one card" decision needs. It does not answer software-stack maturity or porting cost: the page carries hardware figures only, so ROCm coverage and framework versions must be checked against the vendor documentation.
